title: Joining guarded run segments
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $S$ be a state type, let $x$ be a binary string, let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet with states in $S$, let $q\in S$, and let $c,d$ be configurations on input $x$. For $a,b\in\mathbb{N}$, suppose the state at every time $v<a$ in the run from $c$ is different from $q$, the run from $c$ reaches configuration $d$ at time $a$, and the state at every time $v<b$ in the run from $d$ is different from $q$. Then the state at every time $v<a+b$ in the run from $c$ is different from $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a $k$-work-tape machine over binary symbols with states in $S$
the run from $c$ avoids state $q$ at all times below $a$
the run from $c$ is at $d$ at time $a$
the run from $d$ avoids state $q$ at all times below $b$
replaced:
Let a machine avoid a designated anchor state for $a$ steps from $c$, reach $d$
at time $a$, and avoid the anchor for $b$ further steps from $d$. Then it avoids
the anchor at every time below $a + b$ from $c$.
